_provenance.entrances: none: every walk ends at the station point
_provenance.method: city2graph street graph split at Overture connectors; rail, water and motorways dropped. Walk = snap leg + shortest street path + snap leg to the nearest entrance on foot (the station point where none is joined), never below the straight line to where it ends.
